tool.name: CreateInputLayers

param.name: out_gdb
param.dialogReference:
The file geodatabase where the empty layers are created.
Required. Pre-filled with the default geodatabase of the project.

param.name: prefix
param.dialogReference:
Start of the names of the new layers (NB_Sources, NB_Barriers, NB_Receivers, NB_Area).
Default: NB_. If a name exists already, a number is added; nothing is overwritten.

param.name: sr
param.dialogReference:
Coordinate system of the new layers. It must be projected and in metres.
Default: the coordinate system of the active map if it is projected in metres, otherwise ITM (EPSG 2039).

param.name: add_map
param.displayname: Add the layers to the active map
param.dialogReference: Add the new layers to the active map, ready to draw. Default: yes.

tool.summary: Creates empty Sources, Barriers, Receivers and Calculation-area layers with the fields the other tools expect (h_src, Lw_63 ... Lw_8000, h_bar, h_rec) in a geodatabase and adds them to the map, ready to draw or edit.
